join_order.notes: Extract single nationkey, scan supplier with equality check on s_nationkey
Bool array indexed by suppkey (100K entries) for O(1) lookup during partsupp scan

data_structures.supplier_filter: bool_array(100001) indexed by suppkey — O(1) lookup, 100KB fits in L1/L2
data_structures.aggregation: direct_array<double>(2000001) indexed by ps_partkey — 16MB fits in L3 cache, zero hash overhead
data_structures.grand_total: thread-local double accumulators, summed after parallel scan

parallelism.scan: parallel partsupp scan with morsel size 65536
parallelism.aggregation_merge: thread-local direct_arrays merged via simple addition post-scan

execution_steps.name: filter_nation
execution_steps.description: Load 25-row nation table, find nationkey where n_name = :n_name_eq

execution_steps.name: build_supplier_filter
execution_steps.description: Scan 100K supplier rows, set supplier_filter[s_suppkey] = true where s_nationkey == germany_nationkey

execution_steps.name: scan_partsupp_aggregate
execution_steps.description: Parallel morsel-driven scan of 8M partsupp rows. For each row: if supplier_filter[ps_suppkey], compute val = ps_supplycost * (double)ps_availqty, accumulate into thread-local agg_array[ps_partkey] += val and thread-local grand_total += val

execution_steps.name: having_filter
execution_steps.description: Compute threshold = grand_total * 0.0001. Scan agg_array, collect (ps_partkey, value) pairs where value > threshold into result vector (~300K entries, most pass)

execution_steps.name: sort_output
execution_steps.description: Sort results by value DESC. Output all rows.

subquery_optimization: single_pass — grand_total accumulated during same partsupp scan as per-partkey aggregation, avoiding redundant second scan

mmap_strategy.notes: Demand-paged mmap per L3_demand_paged_mmap skill; declare mmap resources before RAII timer per L3_raii_timer_resource_scoping
